purpose: Attempt to replay one authenticated operation across two fresh contracts that share the same operation_id.

expected.safe_condition: The first authorized effect may execute, but a second fresh contract with the same operation_id must be rejected before causing a second effect.

limits: This test measures same-operation replay resistance through the MGnarf v1.70 operation-bound effect path at the exact frozen target commit.
It does not prove distributed multi-host consensus, PostgreSQL fencing, crash recovery, or verifier epistemic independence.
